report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Sections show a meningothelial neoplasm arranged in lobules of syncytial cells with indistinct borders, eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei containing intranuclear pseudoinclusions. The tumour shows high cellularity, sheet-like growth and prominent nucleoli. Mitoses number 6 per 1.6 mm2 (10 high-power fields). Tumour infiltrates the adjacent brain parenchyma. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for EMA and SSTR2A. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 9 per cent.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - ATYPICAL MENINGIOMA, CNS WHO grade 2
- Histological appearance: meningothelial neoplasm, showing high cellularity, sheet-like growth and prominent nucleoli
- Immunohistochemistry: EMA positive; SSTR2A positive
- CNS WHO grade 2
